tip.en: HR reaches 125 on a 4-5% grade at km 0.3 — solid cardiac restraint given your recent Catalina 10K effort. You're settling into this run rather than chasing it.
tip.zh: 在0.3公里处以4-5%坡度跑时心率仅125，相比近期卡塔利纳10K比赛的负荷，今日心率控制得相当克制，状态进入节奏平稳。

title.en: Terrain Anomaly — Possible Stumble or GPS Spike
title.zh: 地形异常——疑似摔跌或GPS漂移

tip.en: At km 2.1 the grade swings violently from -15% to +20% within seconds and pace balloons to 12:49 — telltale of a stumble, curb drop, or sharp GPS bounce. HR held steady at 142, suggesting it was brief. Worth noting as a spot to watch on future laps.
tip.zh: 在2.1公里处坡度在数秒内从-15%骤变至+20%，配速跌至12:49，疑似踩空、路缘台阶或GPS漂移。心率维持142说明事件很短暂，今后跑此路段需留意。

title.en: Two-Minute Walk Break Hidden in the Data
title.zh: 数据中藏着约两分钟的步行间歇

tip.en: Paces of 46:18 and 52:05 at km 2.3 with HR dropping to 131 signal a genuine stop or walk lasting roughly 90-120 seconds. This is fine on a recovery day but worth logging consciously — if it's a shoelace or discomfort, track whether it recurs.
tip.zh: 2.3公里处配速跌至46:18和52:05，心率降至131，说明有约90-120秒的真实停步或步行。恢复日完全可以接受，但建议有意记录原因——若是鞋带或不适，观察是否重复出现。

title.en: Cardiac Ceiling Builds on Flat Ground
title.zh: 平坦路段心率持续攀升至上限

tip.en: From km 3.5 onward HR climbs steadily from 147 to 149 on barely 1% grade at a 6:30-8:00 pace — cardiac drift on flat terrain, not hill effort. After Catalina and several short recovery runs, your aerobic system is still consolidating. This zone is exactly right for today.
tip.zh: 从3.5公里起，心率在近乎平坦的路段（坡度约1%）以6:30-8:00的配速稳步升至149——这是平地心率漂移而非爬坡消耗。后卡塔利纳恢复期中，有氧系统仍在重建，这个心率区间正是今天的合适位置。

title.en: Max Effort Window — HR 151 on a Modest Climb
title.zh: 全程最高心率区间——小坡段触达151

tip.en: HR peaks at 151 between km 3.8-3.9 on a 4-7% ramp while pace slows to 7-9 min/km — this is your honest ceiling for today. Compare to max HR of 166-170 in recent training: you have significant reserve left, confirming this run is functioning as genuine recovery.
tip.zh: 在3.8-3.9公里的4-7%坡段，心率触达151，配速降至7-9分钟/公里——这是今日真实的强度上限。对比近期训练中166-170的最大心率，说明今天储备充足，本次确实是有效的恢复跑。

title.zh: 长段步行下坡体现良好克制

tip.en: From km 4.0 onward HR drops from 141 to 122 over 90 seconds as pace stretches to 12 min/km — a deliberate downhill walk. After hitting your effort ceiling at km 3.9, this is exactly the right response on a recovery day: don't claw pace back, let the body absorb.
tip.zh: 从4.0公里起，90秒内心率从141降至122，配速拉长至12分钟/公里，属于主动步行下坡。在3.9公里达到今日强度上限后，这种处理方式非常正确——恢复日不必急于重拾配速，让身体充分吸收刺激。
